title: Saudi Buckwheat Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful dish from Saudi Arabia, made with buckwheat and traditional spices. This tagine is perfect for a chilly evening or a special occasion.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add buckwheat groats and stir to coat with oil.
Add Saudi spices, tagine spice mix, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until buckwheat is tender.
Fluff with a fork and garnish with chopped parsley (if using).
